Old Necromancer's tower


Setting

Kholai’s tower is the setting for a bargain with an outcast necromancer. A dead scientist’s summoned spirit supplies the fragmentary testimony that changes Zak’s understanding of the missing Joon. [1, 2, 3, 4]

Kholai and the dead scientist

Kehel directs Zak to Kholai, whom Taivo displaced from the imperial laboratory. Kholai wants disgrace for his rival rather than a simple assassination. Zak steals a dead scientist’s head from the laboratory; its disappearance will embarrass Taivo, and Kholai can summon its spirit. The scientist describes a horror pursuing the red-skinned youth. To conceal him, the scholars changed his appearance and sent him away by teleportation. Kholai interprets the broken testimony and tells Zak to search the ruined mansion for the magical object used in the escape. The fragments Zak finds are beyond Kehel’s ability to interpret: only a Great Magician can identify the destination. [5, 2, 6, 3, 4, 7, 8]
